league_premio_reglas: Eligible accounts have at least 10 rounds played with the entered strategy; months not played count as 0%. If there is a tie, the tied accounts share the prizes of their places. Simulated portfolios: not investment advice.
league_sin_jornada_texto: When this month's round begins, you'll see how each strategy is doing here.
league_jornada_fijada_texto: Portfolios are formed on the night of the last trading day. Until half an hour before the market opens you can only swap and restore companies in your portfolio. Once the round starts, the live standings will appear here.
league_jornada_proxima_texto: You can sign up or change your strategy until {date} at {time}. After that, until the round starts, you can only swap companies in your portfolio.
league_clasificacion_vacia_jugando: Points are added when each round closes. Check “This month” to see how the current round is going.

league_clasificacion_vacia_sin_apuntadas: No one has signed up for this season yet.
league_sin_inicio_texto: When the first round begins, you'll see the standings for all strategies against the S&P 500 here.
league_leyenda_orden_rentabilidad: Ranked by the cumulative return of the season.
league_leyenda_orden_puntos: 3 points per round beating the S&P, 1 for a tie. Ties are broken by the margin over the S&P.
league_leyenda_casa: α Alpha, Ω Omega, and λ Lambda are house teams and play by the same rules.
league_leyenda_vs_sp: “vs S&P” shows how far ahead of or behind the index each strategy is for the season.
